mapper.select: SELECT t.order_id, t.payment_key, t.price, w.member_id FROM `transaction` t JOIN wallet w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id WHERE t.order_id = #{orderId} AND t.txn_type = 'DEPOSIT' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `transaction` (wallet_id, pet_id, recurring_id, txn_type, price, category, merchant_name, merchant_category_code, memo, auto_tagged, txn_date) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{petId}, #{recurringId}, #{txnType}, #{price}, #{category}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantCategoryCode}, #{memo}, #{autoTagged}, #{txnDate})

INSERT INTO `transaction` (wallet_id, pet_id, txn_type, price, category, merchant_name, merchant_category_code, memo, auto_tagged, txn_date, payment_key, order_id) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{petId}, #{txnType}, #{price}, #{category}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantCategoryCode}, #{memo}, #{autoTagged}, #{txnDate}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId})
